title: Cad React Renderer Premigration Parity
description:
Bring the CAD experience on the React renderer (SEMIO_RENDERER=react, launch config 🛠️dev📐cad⚛️react, port 6020) to full premigration level (git tag `premigration`, commit f8376e8486). Full maximalism scope per user decision: every premigration feature, including component (face/edge/vertex) selection + ambiguity pick menu, the metadata attributes panel, the full 37+ interaction catalog via a declarative interaction engine, the typology hatch material, STEP import on Load, and archived box footprints.

Confirmed bugs to fix first (Phase 0): Load is broken end-to-end (plugin never string-parses the file payload), REPL numeric entry can never match due to shell command normalization stripping decimals, background-deselect misfires on every click (R3F stopPropagation doesn't stop DOM bubbling), ctrl-click "remove" merge mode unsupported in the shared selection-merge helper, gumball rotate crashes (reads wrong GumballPose field), and engagementRepeatLast is a no-op.

Centerpiece: Phase 1 replaces the 9 hardcoded Rust statecharts in cad/plugin/rs/interaction.rs with a declarative interaction engine that interprets the in-tree JSON interaction/action assets (cad/asset/modelDefinition/*/interaction/*.json, ~37 for spatial.shape alone) against cad/schema/json/interaction.json and expression.json, executing via kernel_3d_brepkit sync ops.

Full plan with file:line references is in /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/get-cad-to-premigration-stateful-rabbit.md (5 phases + Phase 0 bugs). Architecture constraint: shell/host code (framework/renderer/react, infinite/world/r3f) stays renderer-generic — no cad-specific branches; all cad logic lives in the Rust plugin (cad/plugin/rs, cad/rs). Working tree has concurrent WIP in framework/renderer/react/components/world-3d-host.tsx and lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs from an unrelated lowpoly parity session — all edits here must be additive and must not revert those hunks.
summary:
Brought the cad React renderer substantially toward premigration parity. Full details and remaining scope in the plan file (/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/get-cad-to-premigration-stateful-rabbit.md).

DONE & VERIFIED (99 Rust tests + 64 vitest tests, 0 failures; one live dev-server smoke test):
- Phase 0 (6 confirmed bugs): Load round-trip string-payload parsing, REPL decimal/numeric entry (shell normalizer + plugin parser), background-deselect misfire (onPointerMissed), ctrl-click "remove" merge mode, gumball rotate crash (wrong GumballPose field), engagementRepeatLast no-op. Also fixed unrelated pre-existing breakages blocking verification: a wasm-only macro missing a #[cfg] gate (broke every native plugin build/test), a stale RasterScene scaffold constructor, a UiFieldNode.child type-migration gap, and two stale forest-fixture test assertions (extent-from-geometry was genuinely unimplemented — now real).
- Phase 1 (declarative interaction engine, the plan's centerpiece): full InteractionSpec/Expr type system + evaluator in cad/rs/lib.rs mirroring cad/schema/json/interaction.json + expression.json. cad/plugin/rs/interaction.rs rewritten around a generic statechart interpreter driven by all 49 real JSON interaction assets (embedded via include_str!), replacing 9 hand-written statecharts. Commit-action runner covers box (full multi-mode flow, matching the JSON's authentic point/diagonal branching — a real premigration-fidelity improvement over the old 2-corner-only flow), a shared "2 points + height" builder (12 energy/structure-classic/fem constructions), and command.finish/sphere. The 4 building.building.* interactions (no JSON asset exists for aec.building) kept as an isolated legacy fallback. Live-verified in the real dev server: wasm plugin loads cleanly, the full 37-item spatial.shape catalog renders in the toolbar, clicking "Box" starts a real engagement session (Step: first_corner) exactly matching the engine.
- Phase 2 (core): worldPointerMove command + generic pointer.move handling (same engine, no special-casing) drives live rubber-band previews. Host-side handlePointerMove now raycasts + dispatches worldPointerMove (rAF-throttled) during an active session. Added linear-handle preview rendering; fixed box-preview to use the explicit height field instead of inferring it from corner z-difference.
- Added a cad-react-dev entry to .claude/launch.json (port 6020) — was missing entirely.

NOT STARTED (explicit follow-up, documented in the plan file): Phase 2 remainder (constrained height-yz/vertical-z raycasts, label/preview/entity-highlight/curve/mesh display rendering, archived box footprints); Phase 3 (component/face/edge/vertex selection + pick menu); Phase 4 (stats/attributes panels, delete key, STEP import, forest-right example); Phase 5 (camera projection/named views, reference relocate, typology material/hatch shader). Most spatial.shape interactions beyond box/sphere/2-points-height have no commit-action implementation yet (booleans, fillet/chamfer, loft/sweep, curve tools, transforms) — their state machines are fully navigable (specs load, guards/effects/previews work) but commit returns None, matching the pre-engine fallback. Box's advanced sub-modes and the curve-drawing sub-flow (interaction.call composition) are also deferred.

Environment note: this machine's wasm32-wasip2 DEBUG build crashes the LLD linker (confirmed pre-existing/environment-wide via an unrelated plugin) — the --release build (what the real dev pipeline uses) works fine and was used for live verification.
